text:
gita (Design): Heads-up from research: users confused by disabled role selector in Invite modal when Org SSO is enabled. They click it, expect to change role, then get surprised invites have different roles.
omar (PM): saw two support tickets this week. Need clearer affordance and a path to provisioning.
leo (FE): current approach is a disabled <select>. Disabled controls are skipped by keyboard and screen readers. Quick fix: replace with a read-only row + an accessible info control.
anya (A11y): yes — info must be tabbable and use aria-describedby or aria-controls for the explainer. If we use a dialog, add aria-labelledby and ensure we don't trap focus unless modal. Color contrast for muted text also needs checking.
gita (Design): two options: 1) small inline drawer anchored to the role row showing recent audit events (keeps context), or 2) unobtrusive dialog/docs link explaining "Roles managed by SSO". Which feels lower friction?
omar (PM): prioritize the dialog/docs link as a hotfix. Drawer is nice but larger effort. Hotfix to reduce ticket volume ASAP. Drawer POC for next sprint.
leo (FE): plan: hotfix = swap disabled select -> read-only row with label "Roles managed by SSO" + info button that opens a small dialog (non-modal) with copy and link to provisioning docs. Will ensure button is tabbable and dialog has aria attributes.
anya (A11y): include these a11y checks in acceptance: 1) info button is reachable by keyboard; 2) dialog announced by screen readers (aria-labelledby); 3) Esc closes dialog and returns focus; 4) contrast >= 4.5:1. I'll run axe on staging.
gita (Design): dialog copy draft: header "SSO-managed roles" body "Your identity provider controls role assignments for invited users. To change defaults, update provisioning rules in your IdP." Link text: "SSO provisioning docs". Short and actionable.
omar (PM): add a tiny inline note under the email field: "Invited users will receive the role defined by your SSO provider." and for bulk invites (>50) require a confirmation checkbox: "I understand roles will be assigned by our IdP."
leo (FE): will implement both. Quick question: should we ever show the mapped role name from IdP in the modal? Might be confusing.
gita (Design): hold off on dynamic mapping in modal. We can explore a safe, scrubbed "mapping preview" later (no PII). For now keep it generic.
preview-bot: preview build deployed to staging at 2026-03-30T15:45Z (branch hotfix/invite-sso-info) :rocket:
omar (PM): great. Leo, drop PR and staging link and I'll schedule a short keyboard QA tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
